$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天機太陰坐寅申，《深造講義》p.159。

rules.text: 理智型的機月，具幕僚的本質，適合在幕後出謀劃策。
rules.en: A rational Tian Ji–Tai Yin has the nature of an adviser, suited to planning behind the scenes.

source.quote: 理智型的[机月]，具僚幕的本质

rules.text: 情緒型的機月，具藝術氣質，你感受敏銳。
rules.en: An emotional Tian Ji–Tai Yin has an artistic temperament and keen feelings.

source.quote: 情绪型的[机月]，具艺术气质

rules.text: 你的｛天機太陰化祿或化權｝，格局因此高尚。
rules.en: With your ｛Tian Ji or Tai Yin in Abundance or Authority｝, the pattern rises in quality.

source.quote: 化禄、化权仅主格局高尚

rules.text: 你的天機太陰化忌，令理智的一面容易變成自私的行為。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji–Tai Yin is in Obstruction, so the rational side can turn into self-serving behaviour.

source.quote: 则影响理智为自私的行为

rules.text: 你的天機太陰化忌，令情緒的一面容易變成權術手段。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji–Tai Yin is in Obstruction, so the emotional side can turn into manipulation.

rules.text: 天梁所在的那一步運，是你的重要年運：那段時間一定要依正道而行。
rules.en: The phase that runs through Tian Liang is an important one for you: in that time, keep strictly to the straight path.

rules.text: 理智型的你，行到天相所在的運，不宜獨當一面。
rules.en: Being the reasoning kind, in the phase through Tian Xiang, do not take sole charge.

rules.text: 情緒型的你，行到天相所在的運，只要見吉星，也容易自得其樂地度過。
rules.en: Being the feeling kind, the phase through Tian Xiang passes pleasantly enough for you, so long as helpful stars appear.
